fusions.name: Barbed Lash
fusions.desc: Throws a barbed line that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tearing Haul
fusions.desc: A wrenching bite that deals 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one drawn. It leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagged Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Taste of the Catch
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
